fields.id: Rencana mulai Work Order, dipakai saat Accept. Bawaannya satu jam dari sekarang.

fields.label: Reject reason
fields.en: Asked when rejecting. Required; shown afterwards on the Decision tab.
fields.id: Ditanyakan saat Reject. Wajib; ditampilkan kemudian di tab Decision.

title: Maintenance Work Order

purpose.en: The maintenance job card: who repairs or services which machine, the checklist, spare parts, labour and cost. Open it to follow all maintenance jobs and to run one from Draft through Confirm, Start, Done and Close.
purpose.id: Kartu pekerjaan maintenance: siapa memperbaiki atau merawat mesin mana, checklist, suku cadang, tenaga kerja dan biaya. Buka untuk memantau semua pekerjaan maintenance dan menjalankannya dari Draft sampai Confirm, Start, Done dan Close.

keywords: maintenance work order, mwo, wo maintenance, perawatan mesin, perbaikan, preventive, breakdown, corrective, inspection, suku cadang, downtime, generate pm

steps.en: Open Maintenance Work Order. The boxes show All Open, Breakdown, In Progress, Waiting Part, PM Overdue and Done This Month.
steps.id: Buka Maintenance Work Order. Kotak menampilkan All Open, Breakdown, In Progress, Waiting Part, PM Overdue dan Done This Month.

steps.en: Click + New Record for a manual WO: pick Machine, WO Type and Description, then Save. Breakdowns come from Maintenance Request and routine care from Preventive Plan.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk WO manual: pilih Machine, WO Type dan Description, lalu Save. Breakdown datang dari Maintenance Request dan perawatan rutin dari Preventive Plan.

steps.en: The Head of Maintenance can click Generate PM to create Draft WOs for all plans that are due.
steps.id: Kepala Maintenance bisa klik Generate PM untuk membuat WO Draft dari semua plan yang sudah jatuh tempo.

steps.en: In the Draft WO fill the General, Failure and Schedule tabs. Add checklist tasks, spare parts and labour at the bottom with the + buttons.
steps.id: Di WO Draft isi tab General, Failure dan Schedule. Tambah tugas checklist, suku cadang dan tenaga kerja di bagian bawah dengan tombol +.

steps.en: The Head of Maintenance clicks Confirm. The MWO number is created and the WO becomes Scheduled. Back to Draft is possible until it starts.
steps.id: Kepala Maintenance klik Confirm. Nomor MWO dibuat dan WO menjadi Scheduled. Back to Draft masih bisa sampai pekerjaan dimulai.

steps.en: The technician clicks Start (downtime and machine status are recorded), Hold when waiting for a part, Resume, and Done. Done needs every required checklist task to have a result.
steps.id: Teknisi klik Start (downtime dan status mesin dicatat), Hold saat menunggu suku cadang, Resume, lalu Done. Done butuh semua tugas checklist wajib sudah punya hasil.

steps.en: Done closes the downtime and sets the machine Ready. The Head of Maintenance then clicks Close to make the cost final; a preventive plan moves to its next due date.
steps.id: Done menutup downtime dan membuat mesin Ready. Kepala Maintenance lalu klik Close agar biaya final; plan preventif maju ke jatuh tempo berikutnya.

steps.en: A Confirmed WO that is not Done can be Cancelled with a reason. A Draft WO that does not come from a request can be deleted.
steps.id: WO Confirmed yang belum Done bisa di-Cancel dengan alasan. WO Draft yang bukan berasal dari request bisa dihapus.

fields.label: Machine
fields.en: Machine to maintain. Required; locked after the WO leaves Draft.
fields.id: Mesin yang dirawat. Wajib; terkunci setelah WO keluar dari Draft.

fields.label: WO Type
fields.en: Preventive, Breakdown, Corrective or Inspection. Required; locked after Draft.
fields.id: Preventive, Breakdown, Corrective atau Inspection. Wajib; terkunci setelah Draft.

fields.label: Priority
fields.en: P1 Emergency, P2 High, P3 Normal or P4 Low. Locked after Draft.
fields.id: P1 Emergency, P2 High, P3 Normal atau P4 Low. Terkunci setelah Draft.

fields.label: Component
fields.en: Component code of the machine part involved, from Maintenance Codes.
fields.id: Kode komponen bagian mesin yang terkait, dari Maintenance Codes.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: What the job is. Required, up to 255 characters; locked after Draft.
fields.id: Isi pekerjaan. Wajib, maksimal 255 karakter; terkunci setelah Draft.

fields.label: Technician
fields.en: Employee assigned to the job. Type a name and pick. Also used by My Work.
fields.id: Pegawai yang ditugaskan. Ketik nama lalu pilih. Dipakai juga oleh My Work.

fields.label: Machine Stop
fields.en: Yes records downtime when the job starts and blocks the machine on the Scheduling Board. No keeps the machine running.
fields.id: Yes mencatat downtime saat pekerjaan mulai dan memblokir mesin di Scheduling Board. No membiarkan mesin tetap jalan.

fields.label: Machine Status
fields.en: Current status of the machine. Shown only.
fields.id: Status mesin saat ini. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Problem
fields.en: Failure tab: what went wrong, from Maintenance Codes.
fields.id: Tab Failure: apa yang rusak, dari Maintenance Codes.

fields.label: Cause
fields.en: Failure tab: the cause, from Maintenance Codes.
fields.id: Tab Failure: penyebabnya, dari Maintenance Codes.

fields.label: Action
fields.en: Failure tab: the action taken, from Maintenance Codes.
fields.id: Tab Failure: tindakan yang dilakukan, dari Maintenance Codes.

fields.label: Findings
fields.en: Free text about what the technician found.
fields.id: Teks bebas tentang temuan teknisi.

fields.label: Vendor Service Cost (IDR)
fields.en: Cost of an outside service in rupiah, part of the total cost.
fields.id: Biaya jasa pihak luar dalam rupiah, bagian dari total biaya.

fields.label: Meter at Done (counter)
fields.en: Meter reading when the job is done. Used to schedule the next preventive service by meter.
fields.id: Pembacaan meter saat pekerjaan selesai. Dipakai untuk menjadwalkan servis preventif berikutnya berdasarkan meter.

fields.label: Planned Start
fields.en: Planned start date and time. Locked after Draft.
fields.id: Rencana tanggal dan jam mulai. Terkunci setelah Draft.

fields.label: Planned End
fields.en: Planned end date and time. Locked after Draft.
fields.id: Rencana tanggal dan jam selesai. Terkunci setelah Draft.

fields.label: Est. Duration (minutes)
fields.en: Estimated duration in minutes. Locked after Draft.
fields.id: Perkiraan durasi dalam menit. Terkunci setelah Draft.

fields.label: Actual Start → End
fields.en: Real start and end, filled by Start and Done. Shown only.
fields.id: Mulai dan selesai sebenarnya, terisi oleh Start dan Done. Hanya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Task
fields.en: Checklist: task text. Add extra tasks with + Task. Tasks from a plan are copied here.
fields.id: Checklist: teks tugas. Tambah tugas dengan + Task. Tugas dari plan disalin ke sini.

fields.label: Result
fields.en: Checklist result: OK, Not OK or N/A. Required tasks need a result before Done.
fields.id: Hasil checklist: OK, Not OK atau N/A. Tugas wajib harus punya hasil sebelum Done.

fields.label: Measured
fields.en: Measured value for measuring tasks, compared with the Min and Max range.
fields.id: Nilai ukur untuk tugas pengukuran, dibandingkan dengan rentang Min dan Max.

fields.label: Note
fields.en: Free note on a checklist task or on a labour line.
fields.id: Catatan bebas pada tugas checklist atau baris tenaga kerja.

fields.label: + Spare part
fields.en: Spare parts tab: type 2 or more letters of the code or name of a raw material and pick it, set the Qty, then click + Part. Plan, Used, stock and cost are shown per line.
fields.id: Tab Spare Parts: ketik 2 huruf atau lebih kode atau nama bahan baku lalu pilih, isi Qty, lalu klik + Part. Plan, Used, stok dan biaya tampil per baris.

fields.label: + Technician
fields.en: Labour tab: pick the technician, enter Minutes and Date, then click + Labor. The cost uses the labour rate per hour in Constants.
fields.id: Tab Labor: pilih teknisi, isi Minutes dan Date, lalu klik + Labor. Biaya memakai tarif tenaga kerja per jam di Constants.

title: My Work

purpose.en: A phone-friendly list of the open Maintenance Work Orders of the logged-in technician, with Start, Hold, Resume and Done buttons on each card. Open it on the shop floor to run your jobs.
purpose.id: Daftar Maintenance Work Order terbuka milik teknisi yang login, ramah HP, dengan tombol Start, Hold, Resume dan Done di tiap kartu. Buka di lantai produksi untuk menjalankan pekerjaan Anda.

keywords: my work, pekerjaan saya, tugas teknisi, teknisi, start, hold, resume, done, kartu kerja, maintenance hp, report problem

steps.en: Open My Work. You see the Confirmed WOs assigned to you that are not Cancelled or Closed. The head of maintenance and admin see all open WOs.
steps.id: Buka My Work. Anda melihat WO Confirmed yang ditugaskan ke Anda dan belum Cancelled atau Closed. Kepala maintenance dan admin melihat semua WO terbuka.

steps.en: On a Scheduled card click Start when you begin. Downtime and machine status are recorded.
steps.id: Di kartu berstatus Scheduled klik Start saat mulai bekerja. Downtime dan status mesin dicatat.

steps.en: While In Progress click Hold if you wait for a spare part, or Done when finished. A card on Waiting Part has Resume.
steps.id: Saat In Progress klik Hold bila menunggu suku cadang, atau Done bila selesai. Kartu Waiting Part punya tombol Resume.

steps.en: Click Open to fill the checklist and spare parts in the full Work Order. Done needs all required checklist tasks to have a result.
steps.id: Klik Open untuk mengisi checklist dan suku cadang di Work Order lengkap. Done butuh semua tugas checklist wajib sudah punya hasil.

steps.en: Click Report Problem to open a new Maintenance Request.
steps.id: Klik Report Problem untuk membuka Maintenance Request baru.

fields.label: Report Problem
fields.en: Button that opens a new Maintenance Request.
fields.id: Tombol yang membuka Maintenance Request baru.

fields.label: Start
fields.en: Starts a Scheduled WO. Records actual start, downtime and machine status.
fields.id: Memulai WO Scheduled. Mencatat mulai aktual, downtime dan status mesin.

fields.label: Hold
fields.en: Puts an In Progress WO on Waiting Part.
fields.id: Mengubah WO In Progress menjadi Waiting Part.

fields.label: Resume
fields.en: Continues a WO that is Waiting Part.
fields.id: Melanjutkan WO yang berstatus Waiting Part.

fields.label: Done
fields.en: Finishes the work. Required checklist tasks must have a result; downtime is closed and the machine is Ready again.
fields.id: Menyelesaikan pekerjaan. Tugas checklist wajib harus punya hasil; downtime ditutup dan mesin kembali Ready.

fields.label: Open
fields.en: Opens the full Maintenance Work Order of the card.
fields.id: Membuka Maintenance Work Order lengkap dari kartu.

title: Preventive Plan

purpose.en: A template for routine maintenance or inspection per machine: when it is due (by time and or by meter), the checklist and the standard spare parts. Due plans create Draft Work Orders automatically every day at 06:00. Only the Head of Maintenance edits.
purpose.id: Template perawatan rutin atau inspeksi per mesin: kapan jatuh tempo (berdasarkan waktu dan atau meter), checklist dan suku cadang standar. Plan yang jatuh tempo membuat WO Draft otomatis tiap hari pukul 06:00. Hanya Kepala Maintenance yang mengubah.

keywords: preventive plan, rencana preventif, pm, jadwal perawatan, preventive maintenance, inspeksi, k3, checklist, interval, fixed, floating, generate wo

steps.en: Open Preventive Plan. The grid shows each plan with Last Done, Next Due and Due (Overdue, Due, OK). Expand a row to see its tasks.
steps.id: Buka Preventive Plan. Grid menampilkan tiap plan dengan Last Done, Next Due dan Due (Overdue, Due, OK). Buka baris untuk melihat tugasnya.

steps.en: Head of Maintenance: click + New Record. On the General tab enter the plan code, name, machine, WO type and estimated duration.
steps.id: Kepala Maintenance: klik + New Record. Di tab General isi kode plan, nama, mesin, tipe WO dan perkiraan durasi.

steps.en: On the Trigger tab choose by Time, Meter or Time OR Meter, the interval, Floating or Fixed, and how many days before due the WO is created.
steps.id: Di tab Trigger pilih Time, Meter atau Time OR Meter, intervalnya, Floating atau Fixed, serta berapa hari sebelum jatuh tempo WO dibuat.

steps.en: Click Save. Then add the checklist tasks and the standard spare parts at the bottom.
steps.id: Klik Save. Lalu tambahkan tugas checklist dan suku cadang standar di bagian bawah.

steps.en: Click Generate WO to create a Draft Work Order from the plan right away (not when the plan already has an open WO). Closing that WO moves the plan to its next due date.
steps.id: Klik Generate WO untuk langsung membuat Work Order Draft dari plan (tidak bisa bila plan sudah punya WO terbuka). Menutup WO itu memajukan plan ke jatuh tempo berikutnya.

fields.label: Plan Code
fields.en: Unique code such as PM-OFF01-01. Required.
fields.id: Kode unik seperti PM-OFF01-01. Wajib.

fields.label: Plan Name
fields.en: Name of the plan; becomes the description of the generated WO. Required.
fields.id: Nama plan; menjadi deskripsi WO yang dibuat. Wajib.

fields.label: Machine
fields.en: Machine the plan is for. Required.
fields.id: Mesin tujuan plan. Wajib.

fields.label: WO Type
fields.en: Preventive or Inspection. Required.
fields.id: Preventive atau Inspection. Wajib.

fields.label: Est. Duration (minutes)
fields.en: Estimated duration; sets the planned end of the generated WO.
fields.id: Perkiraan durasi; menentukan rencana selesai WO yang dibuat.

fields.label: Machine Stop
fields.en: Yes if the machine must stop; the WO then blocks the machine on the Scheduling Board.
fields.id: Yes bila mesin harus berhenti; WO lalu memblokir mesin di Scheduling Board.

fields.label: Certificate valid until (inspection)
fields.en: Validity end date of an inspection certificate, for example a safety inspection.
fields.id: Tanggal berakhir masa berlaku sertifikat inspeksi, misalnya inspeksi K3.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.en: Time, Meter or Time OR Meter (first). Required.
fields.id: Time, Meter atau Time OR Meter (first). Wajib.

fields.label: Every
fields.en: Interval number, at least 1. Required unless the trigger is Meter.
fields.id: Angka interval, minimal 1. Wajib kecuali pemicu Meter.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Day, Week, Month or Year. Required unless the trigger is Meter.
fields.id: Day, Week, Month atau Year. Wajib kecuali pemicu Meter.

fields.label: Schedule Mode
fields.en: Floating counts from the last completion; Fixed follows exact calendar dates, for example safety inspections. Required.
fields.id: Floating dihitung dari selesai terakhir; Fixed mengikuti tanggal kalender pasti, misalnya inspeksi K3. Wajib.

fields.label: Meter
fields.en: Run hours or Impressions. Required unless the trigger is Time.
fields.id: Run hours atau Impressions. Wajib kecuali pemicu Time.

fields.label: Or every (meter)
fields.en: Meter interval, for example every 500 run hours. Required unless the trigger is Time.
fields.id: Interval meter, misalnya tiap 500 jam jalan. Wajib kecuali pemicu Time.

fields.label: Create WO before due (days)
fields.en: How many days before the due date the Draft WO is created, 0 to 60. Default 3.
fields.id: Berapa hari sebelum jatuh tempo WO Draft dibuat, 0 sampai 60. Bawaan 3.

fields.label: Next due (Fixed: first date)
fields.en: Next due date. The system calculates it; only for Fixed plans can you type the first date.
fields.id: Tanggal jatuh tempo berikutnya. Dihitung sistem; hanya untuk plan Fixed Anda boleh mengetik tanggal pertama.

fields.label: Last done
fields.en: Date the maintenance was last done.
fields.id: Tanggal perawatan terakhir dilakukan.

fields.label: Meter at last done
fields.en: Meter reading at the last maintenance.
fields.id: Pembacaan meter saat perawatan terakhir.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Free note on the plan.
fields.id: Catatan bebas tentang plan.

fields.label: + Task
fields.en: Tasks tab: type a task, choose its Kind (Inspect, Clean, Lubricate, Adjust, Replace, Measure) and click + Task. Edit text, Measure UoM, Min, Max and Required in the table.
fields.id: Tab Tasks: ketik tugas, pilih Kind (Inspect, Clean, Lubricate, Adjust, Replace, Measure) lalu klik + Task. Ubah teks, Measure UoM, Min, Max dan Required di tabel.

fields.label: + Spare part
fields.en: Spare Parts tab: pick a raw material (2+ letters), set Qty and click + Part. The parts are copied to each generated WO.
fields.id: Tab Spare Parts: pilih bahan baku (2+ huruf), isi Qty lalu klik + Part. Suku cadang disalin ke setiap WO yang dibuat.

title: Maintenance Codes

purpose.en: The catalogue of Component, Problem, Cause and Action codes used on the Failure tab of a Maintenance Work Order and in breakdown analysis. Open it to add or correct a code.
purpose.id: Katalog kode Component, Problem, Cause dan Action yang dipakai di tab Failure Maintenance Work Order dan analisis kerusakan. Buka untuk menambah atau mengoreksi kode.

keywords: maintenance codes, kode maintenance, kode kerusakan, component, problem, cause, action, katalog kerusakan, pareto

steps.en: Open Maintenance Codes. The list is a sheet where you type in the cells.
steps.id: Buka Maintenance Codes. Daftarnya berupa lembar yang diisi langsung di sel.

steps.en: Add a row: choose the Type, then enter the Code and the Name (all required).
steps.id: Tambah baris: pilih Type, lalu isi Code dan Name (semuanya wajib).

steps.en: Fill Machine Type if the code only applies to one machine type; leave it empty for all machines. Use Sort to set the order in lists.
steps.id: Isi Machine Type bila kode hanya berlaku untuk satu tipe mesin; kosongkan untuk semua mesin. Pakai Sort untuk mengatur urutan di daftar.

steps.en: Click Save. Untick Active for a code that should no longer be offered.
steps.id: Klik Save. Hilangkan centang Active untuk kode yang tidak boleh ditawarkan lagi.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Component, Problem, Cause or Action. Required.
fields.id: Component, Problem, Cause atau Action. Wajib.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Short code, saved in capital letters. Required.
fields.id: Kode singkat, disimpan dengan huruf kapital. Wajib.

fields.label: Name
fields.en: Name shown in the lists of the Work Order, in English; other languages come from the dictionary. Required.
fields.id: Nama yang tampil di daftar Work Order, dalam bahasa Inggris; bahasa lain dari kamus. Wajib.

fields.label: Machine Type (blank = all)
fields.en: Machine type the code is limited to. Blank means all machine types.
fields.id: Tipe mesin yang dibatasi untuk kode ini. Kosong berarti semua tipe mesin.

fields.label: Sort
fields.en: Number that sets the order in the dropdown lists.
fields.id: Angka yang menentukan urutan di daftar pilihan.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Tick for codes that can be picked in a Work Order.
fields.id: Centang untuk kode yang boleh dipilih di Work Order.

title: Maintenance WO Report

purpose.en: One row per Confirmed Maintenance Work Order with type, machine, working hours, downtime and cost. Group it by machine, month, type or problem to see where breakdowns and costs come from.
purpose.id: Satu baris per Maintenance Work Order Confirmed dengan tipe, mesin, jam kerja, downtime dan biaya. Kelompokkan menurut mesin, bulan, tipe atau problem untuk melihat sumber kerusakan dan biaya.

keywords: maintenance wo report, laporan maintenance, pareto kerusakan, biaya maintenance, downtime, breakdown per mesin, jam kerja teknisi, laporan perawatan

steps.en: Open the report. Use the boxes All, Breakdown, Preventive and Closed, or the filters Machine, Type, Problem, Technician and Month.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Pakai kotak All, Breakdown, Preventive dan Closed, atau filter Machine, Type, Problem, Technician dan Month.

steps.en: Choose a grouping (Machine, Month, Type, Problem or Technician) to get subtotals of hours and cost per group.
steps.id: Pilih pengelompokan (Machine, Month, Type, Problem atau Technician) untuk mendapat subtotal jam dan biaya per kelompok.

steps.en: Use the Columns button to show Cause, Action, Findings and the cost split (Spare Parts, Labor, Vendor).
steps.id: Pakai tombol Columns untuk menampilkan Cause, Action, Findings dan rincian biaya (Spare Parts, Labor, Vendor).

steps.en: Double-click a row to open the Maintenance Work Order.
steps.id: Klik dua kali sebuah baris untuk membuka Maintenance Work Order.

fields.label: WO
fields.en: Column: Maintenance Work Order number.
fields.id: Kolom: nomor Maintenance Work Order.

fields.label: Planned
fields.en: Column: planned start date.
fields.id: Kolom: tanggal rencana mulai.

fields.label: Month
fields.en: Hidden column and grouping: month of the planned start (year-month).
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi dan pengelompokan: bulan rencana mulai (tahun-bulan).

fields.label: Machine
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: machine code and name.
fields.id: Kolom, filter dan pengelompokan: kode dan nama mesin.

fields.label: Machine Type
fields.en: Hidden column: type of the machine.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: tipe mesin.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: Preventive, Breakdown, Corrective or Inspection.
fields.id: Kolom, filter dan pengelompokan: Preventive, Breakdown, Corrective atau Inspection.

fields.label: Priority
fields.en: Column: P1 to P4.
fields.id: Kolom: P1 sampai P4.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Column: work status of the WO such as Scheduled, In Progress, Waiting Part, Done or Closed.
fields.id: Kolom: status pekerjaan WO seperti Scheduled, In Progress, Waiting Part, Done atau Closed.

fields.label: Technician
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: assigned technician.
fields.id: Kolom, filter dan pengelompokan: teknisi yang ditugaskan.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: Hidden column: description of the WO.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: deskripsi WO.

fields.label: Component
fields.en: Hidden column: component code name.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: nama kode komponen.

fields.label: Problem
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: problem code name. Basis for the breakdown Pareto.
fields.id: Kolom, filter dan pengelompokan: nama kode problem. Dasar Pareto kerusakan.

fields.label: Cause
fields.en: Hidden column: cause code name.
fields.id: Kolom tersembunyi: nama kode penyebab.

fields.label: Action
fields.en: Hidden column: action code name.

title: Complaint Review (QA)

purpose.en: QA answers the customer complaints that Sales confirmed and sent to QA: whose fault it is, the root cause, the corrective and preventive action, and what happens to returned goods.
purpose.id: QA menjawab komplain customer yang sudah di-Confirm Sales dan diteruskan ke QA: salah siapa, akar masalah, tindakan perbaikan dan pencegahan, serta nasib barang yang kembali.

keywords: qa, qc, quality, mutu, komplain customer, review komplain, akar masalah, root cause, capa, tindakan perbaikan, retur penjualan, barang kembali

steps.en: Open the list. It starts with the complaints that still have to be reviewed.
steps.id: Buka daftar. Daftar dibuka dengan komplain yang masih perlu direview.

steps.en: Double-click a complaint. Read the complaint in the Complaint tab and the products in Details.
steps.id: Klik dua kali satu komplain. Baca keluhannya di tab Complaint dan product-nya di Details.

steps.en: Fill in the QA Review tab: Verdict, Root Cause, Corrective Action and Preventive Action.
steps.id: Isi tab QA Review: Verdict, Root Cause, Corrective Action dan Preventive Action.

steps.en: When goods came back, choose Returned Goods: Rework, Scrap or Back to stock.
steps.id: Bila ada barang kembali, pilih Returned Goods: Rework, Scrap atau Back to stock.

steps.en: Click Save to keep a draft answer, or Confirm when the answer is final. After Confirm it cannot be changed and Sales can close the complaint.
steps.id: Klik Save untuk menyimpan jawaban sementara, atau Confirm bila jawaban sudah final. Setelah Confirm tidak bisa diubah dan Sales bisa menutup komplain.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.en: Accepted = our fault, Partly accepted, or Not accepted. Required before Confirm.
fields.id: Accepted = salah kita, Partly accepted, atau Not accepted. Wajib sebelum Confirm.

fields.label: Returned Goods
fields.en: What happens to the goods that came back: Rework, Scrap, Back to stock, or No goods returned. Required when a returned quantity is recorded.
fields.id: Nasib barang yang kembali: Rework, Scrap, Back to stock, atau No goods returned. Wajib bila ada qty kembali.

fields.label: Root Cause
fields.en: Why the problem happened. Required before Confirm.
fields.id: Mengapa masalah terjadi. Wajib sebelum Confirm.

fields.label: Corrective Action
fields.en: What is done to fix this case.
fields.id: Apa yang dilakukan untuk memperbaiki kasus ini.

fields.label: Preventive Action
fields.en: What is changed so it does not happen again.
fields.id: Apa yang diubah supaya tidak terulang.
